title: Immediate financial-fraud reporting
action_text: Use the official financial-fraud reporting route (1930/NCRP) promptly when money may have moved. This prepares a report; it does not establish freezing, recovery, or an FIR.

title: Prompt bank notification
action_text: Notify the affected bank using a verified official channel. Confirm the bank's current process directly; this application does not determine liability or response deadlines.
